name: cronjob
description: Scheduled prompts: recurring jobs ("every 30m", "daily 07:30") and one-shot wake-ups ("in 20m", "at 18:30"). Personal schedules run with their owner's permissions and report in their own conversation or back in the direct chat where they were created. Instance-wide jobs run with owner permissions and report to the notification channel; only the instance owner can manage them.

alerts.runFailed.title: Scheduled job “{job}” failed
alerts.runFailed.body: Details are in the history on the Automation page. Error: {error}
alerts.runUndelivered.title: The result of scheduled job “{job}” could not be delivered
alerts.runUndelivered.body: The job ran, but its result did not reach your conversation. You can find it in the history on the Automation page.

configSchema.label: Scheduler
configSchema.hint: Tick interval, retry behavior and the guard check timeout.

configSchema.label: Tick interval (ms)
configSchema.hint: How often due jobs are checked.

configSchema.label: Attempts
configSchema.hint: Total attempts for a recurring job after a temporary request failure. 1 means no retry; the default, 2, means one retry.

configSchema.label: Retry delay (ms)
configSchema.hint: Pause before a retry so the transient condition can clear.

configSchema.label: Check time limit (ms)
configSchema.hint: Time limit for a job's `check` command.

configSchema.label: Check output limit (chars)
configSchema.hint: How many characters of a `check` command's output are passed to the assistant. Raise the limit if the check returns a large summary.

configSchema.label: Cron catch-up window (ms)
configSchema.hint: How far back a five-field cron job looks for a run missed while the daemon was down. Only the most recent missed run is replayed, not the whole backlog. Range: 1 hour to 7 days; default: 24 hours.

configSchema.label: Per-account limits
configSchema.hint: Limits for a non-admin account's personal jobs. Instance-wide jobs have no limit.

configSchema.label: Jobs per account
configSchema.hint: How many scheduled jobs a non-admin account may keep at a time.

configSchema.label: Shortest interval (minutes)
configSchema.hint: The shortest recurring interval a non-admin account may set. Each run uses a model, and the operator pays for it.

strings.title: Automation
strings.sectionHint: Recurring prompts run on schedule. Changes apply within 30 seconds.
strings.deleteDesc: The job “{name}” will be removed permanently.
strings.name: Name
strings.helpSchedule: Use the builder for interval, daily or weekly schedules. Advanced mode preserves raw five-field cron expressions and existing values the builder does not represent.
strings.scheduleAdvancedHint: Enter a valid five-field cron expression. An existing unsupported value is preserved until you edit it.
strings.helpHours: Optional whole-hour window from 0 to 23. You can also set a window across midnight, such as 22-5. Minutes are not allowed.
strings.hoursLegacyHint: This stored value is not an H-H whole-hour window and will remain unchanged until you choose another mode:
strings.helpHeader: On = the delivered message starts with a "⏰ job name" line. Turn off for persona messages in a dedicated channel.
strings.helpCheck: The shell check command runs before the prompt. If it prints nothing, the assistant does not run, saving a model call. Otherwise, its output is passed to the assistant.
strings.helpPrompt: What the assistant does on each run.
strings.helpChannel: Where the result is delivered on Discord. Default = the discord plugin’s notification channel.
strings.helpModel: Which model the job runs on. Default = the server default model.
strings.ownerFieldHint: An instance-wide job runs without an account and sends its result to the notification channel. Assigning it to yourself makes it run with your permissions and shows the result in a separate conversation named after the job.
strings.helpExecutionProject: Files and commands run in this project, independently of conversation filing. Managed projects require a personal job. Project credentials are shared with its members.
strings.executionUnavailable: Execution projects could not be loaded.
strings.helpConversation: Choose where the job appears in the conversation list. This is for organization only. It does not affect the job's context, model, permissions, or where the result is delivered.
strings.conversationRequired: Choose a conversation. A new recurring job is saved once it is filed.
strings.conversationUnavailableHint: The conversation this job was filed under no longer exists. The job keeps running on its schedule. Choose another conversation and file it there.
strings.conversationOwnerHint: The conversation belongs to the previous owner. Choose one the new owner can use.
strings.conversationUnresolvedHint: The filed conversation could not be read just now. The job keeps running on its schedule and its filing is unchanged.
strings.conversationDirectoryUnavailable: This Elowen installation cannot list conversations.
strings.conversationListError: The conversations could not be loaded. Try again.
strings.linkUnavailableHint: It was deleted, or it belongs to another account. Choose a job from the list.
strings.calEmptyHint: Create a one-time reminder or a recurring job.
strings.nextRunPaused: Paused — enabling arms the job from now.
strings.nextRunUnknown: The next run could not be determined.
strings.badgeGuardedHint: A check command runs first. The assistant may not need to reply.
strings.badgeLateHint: Its time has passed; the scheduler handles it on the next tick.
strings.badgeCatchUpHint: A missed slot from downtime is replayed once.
strings.badgeDeferredHint: Outside active hours, the run is deferred until later today.
strings.createReplayed: The job already exists. No duplicate was created.
strings.createPayloadMismatch: The request was already used with different content
strings.hoursTimeZone: Times are in the scheduler timezone.
strings.helpCreatePrompt: Briefly say what the assistant should do. Shorter is better.
strings.runResultGone: The full transcript is no longer available. The preview above was retained.
strings.dayNothing: Nothing ran or is scheduled for this day.
strings.historyEmptyHint: Run history is recorded from this upgrade onward.
strings.runNoneForDay: No run of this job was recorded that day.
strings.presetHint: Pick a starting point; every field stays editable.
strings.presetDigestPrompt: Prepare a short digest of the day: what is scheduled, what is waiting for a decision and anything that needs attention.
strings.presetInboxPrompt: Check for new messages and report only what requires an answer or a decision.
strings.presetWeeklyPrompt: Summarise the past week: what was finished, what is still open and what is planned for the coming week.
strings.presetReminderPrompt: Remind me about the task below and tell me what its current state is.
strings.runLoadError: The run could not be loaded
